entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated full-body 2D fighting-game character sprite, native transparent background, portrait canvas. Original character for a fan-made Death Stranding-inspired coastal logistics story, not an official character: Maëlle 'Balise' Rocher, an athletic 38-year-old woman with short black hair and a practical weathered face. She wears a grounded graphite waterproof courier suit, a small orange rescue half-plastron, asymmetrical harness, a neatly secured coil of rope on her left hip, metal carabiners and heavy expedition boots. High-end realistic painted videogame character rendering, sharp fabric, realistic weathered polymer and metal textures, muted cold palette, fine readable silhouette. Strict side-on 2D combat view facing RIGHT, torso turned only slightly toward camera, both boots planted in a neutral defensive balanced stance, hands loosely guarding without attacking. Entire head, hands, every accessory and both boots inside canvas, generous clear margin, human anatomy. Camera at hip height, no perspective foreshortening. Soft neutral studio illumination, no glow. Exactly ONE subject, no background, no ground plane, no cast ground shadow, no labels, no watermark, no logos, no BB pod, no skull mask, no magical effects, no fantasy armor, no panels or sprite sheet. Request a genuine transparent alpha background, not a checkerboard painted into the picture.
